winner_reason: Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform is the clearest frontier-step change in AI infrastructure announced this week, with strong, credible coverage, direct impact on the economics of large-scale training, and high long-tail SEO value for explainers on next-gen GPUs and rack-scale AI. It also avoids the recent Robotics/Models streak, incurring no diversity penalty and edging out Stargate UAE on evergreen search potential and concreteness.

scored.notes: Major next-gen platform from the dominant AI hardware vendor; specific performance and cost claims (5x training, 1/4 GPUs, 1/7 token cost) give strong hooks for technical explainers and cost-analysis pieces. Strong CES timing and high media visibility. Distinct from recent Robotics/Models coverage, so no diversity penalty.

High strategic significance in robotics ("Android of robotics" angle), but Robotics has been used heavily in recent weeks, so maximum diversity penalty. Good SEO around 'robot foundation models' and 'generalist robotics platform', but still behind Vera Rubin after penalties.

Large acquisition and notable signal that automotive autonomy players are moving into humanoids. Strong business/strategy story, but less technical depth and evergreen explainer potential than Nvidia’s stack stories; heavily penalized for Robotics repetition.

Important deployment roadmap and scale signal (30,000 robots/year, 2028+), but still prospective and tied to a specific factory/program; good for trend pieces but weaker evergreen search than infra/platform stories. Robotics repetition hurts score.

Interesting convergence of DeepMind-scale models with Atlas humanoids. Solid SEO around 'robot foundation model' and 'Atlas AI', but still narrower and more speculative than a flagship GPU platform; diversity penalty keeps it below the winner.

Clear CES trend and good consumer-interest angle (companion robots, robot pets). Good SEO for product roundups and 'AI companion robot' queries, but more faddish and product-specific than deep infra topics, so lower news impact than Vera Rubin.

Incremental policy/legal update, important for enterprise users but niche and relatively dry. Moderate evergreen value for compliance/search, but lower mass interest and momentum versus hardware/infrastructure stories.

Stargate UAE underscores sovereign-scale AI infra and geopolitics of compute. Strong impact and good SEO around 'AI data center', 'multi-GW clusters', and cross-border AI infrastructure. Slightly less technical/spec-specific than Vera Rubin, so slightly weaker evergreen depth for detailed explainer content.
